plan.question: 고정 특징과 GCN/FМ의 추가 이득이 있는가? 같은 과거 기록과 예산에서 비그래프 MLP·XGBoost보다 현재 모형이 나은가?
plan.hypothesis: 동일 예산 full GCN의 3월 거래 건수 Poisson deviance가 2월에서 선택한 최선 비그래프 대조군보다1% 이상 낮고,3일·7일 paired block bootstrap95% 개선 구간 하한이 모두0보다 크다. 특징별 제거와 FM은 사전 명시한 보조 검증으로 분리한다.

prior_art.title: GCN, Kipf and Welling
prior_art.verified_scope: 원문 그래프 특징 전파 식과 Figure1. 이 프로젝트는 고정 OD집계와 자기/이웃 투영이다.
prior_art.difference_to_test: neighbor 제거와 station-shuffled neighbor로 올바른 관계의 추가 가치를 비교

prior_art.title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
prior_art.verified_scope: 조건부 속도장 회귀와 ODE생성. 독립 Gaussian residual FM을 구현해 비교.
prior_art.difference_to_test: 동일 full rate network의 Poisson과 FM count energy를 비교

prior_art.title: XGBoost parameters
prior_art.verified_scope: count:poisson,base_margin,hist/device 및 boosting parameter 정의. 실제 패키지는3.1.1로 고정.
prior_art.difference_to_test: 같은 기존 입력 원천을 쓰는 tree count predictor와 neural GCN 비교

data.observed_truth: Completed rental and return counts in next10min, not measured stock, unmet demand or dispatch outcomes.
data.api_access: No API path or loader, no new September evaluation in this experiment.

architecture.reference: H13 own164/neighbor72,hidden256,2hidden layers; no new input source or capacity increase

masks.no_graph: All neighbor72 inputs zero; own inputs unchanged (standalone station MLP).
masks.shuffled_neighbors: Use neighbor log/embedding/recent inputs of permuted station index; one permutationPCG64(20261110) shared across seeds; preserves feature shapes and marginal neighbor feature distribution.
masks.no_calendar: Only explicit calendar35 and phase3 zero; calendar information in fixed historical priors remains.
masks.no_recent: Own2 and neighbor2 recent inputs zero.
masks.no_embedding: Own z64 and neighbor Az64 zero; neighbor log/recent remain.
masks.no_pretrain: Random weekly encoder initialization, other heads and sample budgets unchanged; all target parameters trained.

architecture.tree: XGBoost two separate count:poisson outputs. Existing own164+neighbor72 features with frozen source-only Seoul encoder(seed11) and fixed OD. base_margin=log(prior10). Thus an engineered historical embedding baseline, not raw-only XGBoost. Fixed source encoder is not target/full-GCN-trained.

training.early_selection: minimum February deviance on fixed131072 validation exposures PCG64(20261110), epoch0 included, earliest tie
training.source: H12 source-only Seoul encoder; all target encoder layers fine-tuned except no_embedding unused path
training.flow_selection: full only, frozen rate network, February131072 exposures, identical seeded noise every validation, minimum flow MSE, earliest tie
training.flow: H13 CountFlow256/128,log residual dequantization,Gaussian source,Heun16,128IID particles

xgboost.cpu_fallback: If CUDA fails for the installed wheel before a valid fit, log the failure and retry this exact tree configuration on dislab CPU; no parameter selection.

training.budget: One batch experiment; up to60min total. Never kill unrelated jobs. OOM/failure retained; no adaptive hyperparameter expansion.

evaluation.design: H13 historical preprocessing/IDs/OD/profile/normalization/masks fixed by hashes. Train before2026-02; Februarycheckpoint selection only; March262144 fixed station-time draws for count mean deviance and mean MAE. A fixed32768 subset of the same test draws is used for128-particle energy comparisons. March is previously exposed, not an untouched test. Choose best non-graph control by February validation among prior,no_graph,XGBoost before opening March predictions. Mean scores use ensemble mean rate, distribution scores use IID per-particle seed mixture. No API is opened or used in training/choice/calibration. Do not change deployed default automatically.

primary_metric.name: March completed-count Poisson deviance of ensemble mean

evaluation.success_rule: Full vs February-selected non-graph baseline:>=1% relative deviance reduction and both3/7day block95%CI lower>0. Tested-set rank reported separately; no global best claim.
evaluation.failure_rule: Not_supported if point gain<1% or point gain<=0; if point>=1% but either interval includes0, inconclusive. A feature is supported only with>=1% gain and both simultaneous intervals lower>0; harmed if<=-1% and both upper<0; otherwise no demonstrated practically meaningful gain, not equality.
evaluation.exclusion_rule: Reuse only original valid historical intervals, first training station timestamps and existing missing/duplicate/outage rules. Uniform time then station sampling rejection; no condition on future outcomes. Never drop a zero-count sample. No inventory reconstruction truth.
evaluation.uncertainty_plan: Paired moving day blocks3 and7,20000 replicates PCG64(20261110); ratio of resampled sums/exposures. Seven feature contrasts full-vs-ablated use Bonferroni alpha=.05/14 across seven contrasts and two block lengths. FM full vs same full Poisson energy secondary uses95%CI at both block lengths and>=1% gain. Energy=mean||X-y||-.5mean||X_first64-X_last64||, independent paired particles. Report MAE,per-seed scores and day support. Reference H13/H22 and group summaries descriptive only.
evaluation.seed_plan: Training11/29, sample/negative-control/bootstrap20261110, flow evaluation streams20261110+batch_start; seed mixture IID for every particle.
evaluation.secondary: Feature activity/missing-mask audit on historical training support; direct sparsity and night/day group scores; wall time/parameter/file size. Historical weather values are lagged; revised receipt timestamps remain unobserved. Runtime currently uses missing-weather encoding, so a retrospective weather gain does not prove live gain. Recent API stock delta is a deployment proxy for historical completed net flow; this test does not validate that distribution shift.
